title: Pays for counter shows the number of customers billed to the payer
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, the payer.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, whose Bill Invoices To is saved as customer B, so customer B pays for customer A.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer C, whose Bill Invoices To is also saved as customer B, so customer B pays for two customers.
custom_steps:
1. Open customer B's page.
  2. Hover over the "Pays for" counter.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • A "Pays for" counter shows beside Contacts and Assets on customer B's card.
  • The counter shows 2.

Step 2:

  • The tooltip reads "Customers billed to this customer by default".

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12303 (Story 1, Saved default Bill To on the customer page)

  • S1-R7: “When at least one customer has this customer as its default, the card shows a "Pays for" counter beside Contacts and Assets, with the count.”
  • S1-R8: “The counter's tooltip reads "Customers billed to this customer by default".”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Pays for | Counter tooltip / window | "Customers billed to this customer by default" / "[customer] pays for" / "These customers bill new work orders and part sales to [customer] by default." | Tooltip; window with "Close"”
